svg.title: BERT: [CLS] classification and span-based QA
svg.desc: BERT sums token, position, and segment embeddings, then uses a bidirectional encoder. The [CLS] representation feeds a next-sentence classifier; extractive QA uses separate start and end heads and selects the best span with i≤j.

g.text: Segment, position, and token embeddings feed a bidirectional encoder.
